purpose: Public definition of the molecular system; contains no reference energies, winning candidate, or result-bearing stationary-point geometry.

catalyst_model.name: truncated (2,2'-bipyridyl)iron(II) dihydride
catalyst_model.definition: One Fe(II) atom coordinated by both nitrogens of unsubstituted 2,2'-bipyridine, two terminal hydrides, and two axial tetrahydrofuran ligands in the resting octahedral model. The framework is omitted.
catalyst_model.model_boundary: For the reactive tetrahedral state, axial THF ligands may be dissociated; report explicitly which ligands are present in every computed species. Do not import a result-bearing geometry from the paper.

environment.standard_state: state the convention used for relative Gibbs energies

energy_zero_definition: Use the dissociated tetrahedral (bpy)FeH2 active-site state as the zero of the reported relative profile, and state any alternative reference conversion.
allowed_external_inputs: No literature or general web search is needed; standard physical constants and the chosen quantum-chemistry implementation are allowed.
identity_notes: The names and SMILES identify atom connectivity; hydride count, neutral charge, Fe(II) oxidation state, quintet multiplicity, and THF coordination are mandatory model constraints. Generate and document 3D conformers independently.
